protocol.alignment: current wheel contact points projected with camera calibration; RGB and motion at identical timestamps
protocol.visibility_assumption: robot geometry hidden only in RGB; this is an idealized contact view, not front-camera anticipation
protocol.visual_relation: training texture family statistically associated with mu range; exceptions and reversed mappings retained
protocol.supervision: future observed motion; physical parameter metadata and truth are audit/test scoring only
protocol.units: v m/s, yaw rad/s, wheel rates rad/s, nominal commands N
protocol.split: complete episodes, texture seeds, input seeds and noise seeds are disjoint
